name: Fellowship
description: The mutual support and belonging that come from gathering with other believers. Verses about worshiping together, serving one another, and the strength found in community.

verses.note: We're in this thing together. We need each other

name: Jesus Christ - Character
description: The character and attributes of Jesus Christ. Verses that show who he is, what he values, etc.

name: Prayer
description: The act of praying, communicating with God, our Heavenly Father.

verses.note: God is no respecter of persons. He sees the heart.
The Savior spent time alone to pray.
Prayer is not something you do once a day or only when you need help. It is meant to be continuous, woven through your whole life and all your activities.
Fervent prayer works. It brings about real change.
We're commanded to always give thanks no matter what situation we're in.
Counseling with the Lord means praying to him. Prayer is how we bring our concerns and choices to God for his direction.
Jesus prayed to the Father, and his words were so great they could not be captured in language or writing.

name: Repentance
description: Turning away from sin and returning to God. Verses about genuine change of heart, forsaking wrongdoing, and making amends.

name: Riches and Wealth
description: What the Lord teaches about money and material wealth. Verses about the proper place of riches in a faithful life, the danger of loving wealth, and how God views the possession of material goods.

verses.note: I like the word durable here. Physical earthly riches are indeed temporary. They die when we die.
